name: ai.airboxship/shipping-public
title: AirboxShip Shipping (public)
description: Find USPS pickup points, compare USPS and UPS rates, track USPS packages. No sign-in.

tools.name: find_pickup_hubs
tools.description:
Find nearby USPS Post Offices and Smart Lockers for package pickup/drop-off.

    Returns each location's id, name, type, address and distance in miles. This is a
    look-up only; it does not buy a label or reserve anything.

location.description: Address, place name or ZIP code, e.g. '94103' or '123 Main St, San Francisco, CA'
location.title: Location

tools.name: get_shipping_rates
tools.description:
Get shipping rates (postage cost and delivery time) for mailing a package with USPS or UPS
    home delivery, between two US addresses.

    Returns each option's carrier, service, price in USD and estimated delivery time at the
    standard price. Quotes are indicative and not reserved. This tool only quotes prices; it
    does not buy a label.

sender_name.description: Full name of the person or business at this address
sender_name.title: Sender Name

sender_street1.description: Street address line, e.g. '123 Main St'
sender_street1.title: Sender Street1

recipient_name.description: Full name of the person or business at this address
recipient_name.title: Recipient Name

recipient_street1.description: Street address line, e.g. '123 Main St'
recipient_street1.title: Recipient Street1

tools.name: track_package
tools.description:
Look up the current status of a USPS package by its tracking number.

    Returns the status, USPS's one-line summary, the expected delivery date and the latest scan
    (what happened, when, and the city and state). The same information usps.com shows anyone who
    has the number. USPS packages only: a UPS number gets an error pointing to ups.com.
